name: Strat AI — X Marketing Automation (60 Day Campaign)

parameters.content:
## SETUP — do this once, then the workflow is autonomous

**1. Google Sheet** — sheetId is already prefilled (`1KTQQAOQpPzCQxUL_cEjqgHSXVxgqI1QQQ1XIy8cT0bI`). Add two tabs to it:

`Posts` (header row, exact spelling):
`Campaign Day | Theme | Post # | Post Text | Scheduled Time | Status | Tweet ID | Created | Posted`

`Logs` (header row):
`Timestamp | Campaign Day | Theme | Event | Model | Tokens | Posts | Status | Error`

**2. Open the `Config` node** and check:
- `campaignStartDate` — Day 1 of the 60 day campaign (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `notifyEmail` / `fromEmail` — currently placeholders
- `model` / `llmBaseUrl` / `llmApiKey` — prefilled for the OpenAI-compatible gateway (`cx/gpt-5.5-xhigh` @ omniroute). Both LLM calls are plain HTTP Request nodes, so any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.

Also set the same `sheetId`, `timezone` and `notifyEmail` in the **Dispatch Config** node (Section B) and the email address in **Send Error Alert Email** (Section C).

**3. Credentials** — Google Sheets (OAuth2), X / Twitter (OAuth2), Gmail (OAuth2). No OpenAI credential needed.

All four mail nodes use the **Gmail** node. Gmail always sends from the authenticated Google account, so `fromEmail` in Config is informational only — the Google account you connect *is* the sender. Only `notifyEmail` decides where mail lands.

Gmail OAuth2 setup: Google Cloud console → enable the **Gmail API** → OAuth client (Web application) → paste n8n's OAuth Redirect URL → scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send` (n8n requests it) → connect. If the app is in Testing, add your address under OAuth consent screen → Test users. The same Google project can serve the Sheets credential; they are still two separate n8n credentials.

Optional hardening: move the key out of `Config` into a Header Auth credential (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`) and attach it to **Generate Tweets** + **Regenerate Invalid Tweets** instead of the inline header.

**4. Settings → Error Workflow** — point this workflow at itself so the Error Trigger fires.

**5. Activate.** Section A generates at 08:00 IST. Section B publishes due posts every 5 minutes.

X has no native scheduling endpoint, so the schedule lives in the sheet and the dispatcher publishes each post at its stored time (+/- 15 min randomised).

## SECTION A — Daily Generation (08:00 IST)
Cron → load database → resolve campaign day + theme → skip if already generated → generate 5 posts with campaign memory → validate → repair once if needed → save → schedule → email today's plan → log.

## SECTION B — Scheduled Publisher (every 5 minutes)
Reads the sheet, finds posts whose scheduled time has arrived, publishes via the official X API node (3 automatic retries), stores the returned Tweet ID, marks failures and alerts.

## SECTION C — Failure Alerting
Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow (Settings → Error Workflow). Any exhausted retry on OpenAI, Google Sheets or X lands here and emails immediately.

// Resolves campaign day, theme, content mix, hook rotation, schedule and the AI prompts.
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
const zone = cfg.timezone || 'Asia/Kolkata';
const site = cfg.website || 'https://www.stratai.live';
const now = $now.setZone(zone);
const today = now.startOf('day');
const start = DateTime.fromISO(String(cfg.campaignStartDate), { zone }).startOf('day');

let day = Math.floor(today.diff(start, 'days').days) + 1;
if (!Number.isFinite(day) || day < 1) { day = 1; }
if (day > 60) { day = ((day - 1) % 60) + 1; }

const THEMES = [
  'Information Overload',
  'Sometimes No Trade Is The Best Trade',
  'Decision Intelligence',
  'Institutional Thinking',
  'Risk Management',
  'Why Charts Only Show The Past',
  'Conviction Without Evidence',
  'Confluence Over Single Indicators',
  'Market Structure Basics',
  'Multi Timeframe Alignment',
  'Market Regimes',
  'Relative Strength Against The Index',
  'Order Flow: Who Is Actually Pressing',
  'Volume Profile And The Point Of Control',
  'Support, Resistance And The Opening Range',
  'Chart Patterns Without Superstition',
  'Volatility Is Not Risk',
  'The ATR Stop Rule',
  'Risk To Reward Math',
  'Position Sizing',
  "The Devil's Advocate",
  'Bull Versus Bear Debate',
  'Consensus, Contested And Conviction',
  'The Conviction Score One To Hundred',
  'Fusing Technicals With Sentiment',
  'The Capital Protection Guardrail',
  'News Is A Calibration Not A Trigger',
  'Anomaly Detection',
  'Predictive Ghost Lines',
  'R Squared: Knowing How Much To Trust A Projection',
  'Honest Failure Over Fabrication',
  'Glass Box Versus Black Box',
  'Why We Are Not A Signal Provider',
  'The Trade Journal',
  'Expectancy Beats Win Rate',
  'Track Record Calibration',
  'Session Awareness Through The NSE Day',
  'Expiry Day Distortion',
  'Options Positioning: PCR, Max Pain, OI Walls',
  'Event Risk And Earnings Gates',
  'The First Account I Blew Up',
  'Why We Wrote The Core In Rust',
  'Sub Second Data Pipelines',
  'Why We Chose A Desktop Terminal',
  'Five Years Of History',
  'Footprint Charts',
  'Three Trader Profiles',
  'Margin, Positions And Reality',
  'Bounded Reasoning: Why AI Must Terminate',
  'Hard Rules The AI Cannot Override',
  'From Vibe Coding To Vibe Trading',
  'What Retail Has That Institutions Do Not',
  'The Psychology Of Being Stopped Out',
  'Overtrading',
  'Journaling Without Lying To Yourself',
  'Backtests Versus Reality',
  'Automation Is Not Abdication',
  'Building In Public',
  'What We Got Wrong',
  'Institutional Intelligence For Every Trader'
];

const CAPABILITIES = [
  'AI Trade Discovery (FIND mode)',
  'AI Trade Verification (VERIFY mode)',
  'AI Bull versus Bear Debate',
  'The Judge Agent and calibrated conviction',
  'Market Structure Analysis',
  'Multi timeframe macro alignment (1H, 4H, 1D)',
  'Market Regime Classification',
  'Relative Strength versus NIFTY 50',
  'Order Flow Imbalance and cumulative volume delta',
  'Volume Profile and the Point of Control',
  'Footprint order flow rendering',
  'Nineteen institutional chart patterns with confidence scores',
  'VWEPR quadratic curvature',
  'The volatility aware Directional Forecaster',
  'News Sentiment as a calibration input',
  'Options chain intelligence: PCR, max pain, OI walls',
  'The Event Risk Gate',
  'Track Record Calibration',
  'Risk Validation: the 1.5x ATR stop rule and R:R floors',
  'Predictive Ghost Lines with an R squared confidence score',
  'The Fused Conviction Score from 1 to 100',
  'The Capital Protection Guardrail that forces HOLD on conflict',
  'Glass box streamed reasoning',
  'Honest failure over fabrication',
  'Session and expiry awareness',
  'Three tailored profiles: Intraday, Swing, Investor',
  'The sub second Rust tick pipeline',
  'The self scoring trade journal and expectancy tracking',
  'The Bear Agent devil advocate critique',
  'QA mode interactive auditing'
];

const HOOKS = [
  'What if...', 'Nobody talks about...', 'The biggest mistake...', 'Most traders...',
  'Three friends...', 'This changed...', 'Why do...', 'Everyone wants...',
  'Retail traders...', 'The market does not...', 'Here is what...', 'Unpopular opinion...',
  'A hard truth...', 'It took years to learn...', 'The first time...', 'Ask yourself...',
  'There is a reason...', 'Two traders...', 'Consider this...', 'Something changed when...',
  'The problem is not...', 'Before you...', 'A quiet observation...', 'Institutions do not...',
  'You already know...', 'One number...', 'The uncomfortable part...', 'Nothing about...',
  'Every losing trade...', 'We removed...', 'We rebuilt...', 'A question we keep hearing...',
  'The day I...', 'What nobody tells...', 'Imagine...', 'If you have ever...',
  'Screens do not...', 'A small change...', 'The gap between...', 'Say it plainly...'
];

const theme = THEMES[day - 1];

// Content mix: 35 / 20 / 15 / 10 / 10 / 10 spread across a rolling 100 slot pool,
// so every 20 days the campaign lands exactly on the requested percentages.
const MIX_DEF = [['Educational', 35], ['Founder Journey', 20], ['Product Philosophy', 15], ['Behind The Scenes', 10], ['Question', 10], ['Community Engagement', 10]];
const buckets = MIX_DEF.map(d => ({ name: d[0], left: d[1], weight: d[1] }));
const POOL = [];
for (let s = 0; s < 100; s++) {
  buckets.sort((a, b) => (b.left / b.weight) - (a.left / a.weight));
  buckets[0].left -= 1;
  POOL.push(buckets[0].name);
}

const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r && r['Post Text']);
const todays = rows.filter(r => String(r['Campaign Day']) === String(day));
const alreadyGenerated = todays.length >= 5;

const history = rows.slice(-300);
const memoryBlock = history.length
  ? history.map(r => '- D' + r['Campaign Day'] + ': ' + String(r['Post Text']).split('\n').join(' ')).join('\n')
  : '(none yet - this is the opening day of the campaign)';
const openers = Array.from(new Set(history.slice(-80).map(r => String(r['Post Text']).trim().split(' ').slice(0, 4).join(' ')))).join(' | ') || '(none)';

const contentTypes = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => POOL[((day - 1) * 5 + i) % 100]);
const hooks = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => HOOKS[((day - 1) * 5 + i) % HOOKS.length]);
const focusCapability = CAPABILITIES[(day - 1) % CAPABILITIES.length];

const SLOTS = ['09:00', '12:30', '15:30', '18:30', '21:30'];
const schedule = SLOTS.map((s, i) => {
  const p = s.split(':');
  const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 31) - 15; // +/- 15 minutes
  const dt = today.set({ hour: Number(p[0]), minute: Number(p[1]), second: 0, millisecond: 0 }).plus({ minutes: jitter });
  return { postNumber: i + 1, baseSlot: s, iso: dt.toISO(), display: dt.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy HH:mm') + ' IST' };
});

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are the Head of Content for Strat AI (' + site + '), an AI native trading intelligence terminal for Indian stock market traders on the NSE.',
  '',
  'WHAT STRAT AI IS',
  '- A decision intelligence terminal. It is NOT a charting platform and it is NEVER a signal provider, tip service or calls channel.',
  '- Traditional platforms show what already happened. Strat AI helps a trader decide what to do next, before capital is risked.',
  '- Primary positioning: Institutional Intelligence for Every Trader. Secondary: From Vibe Coding to Vibe Trading.',
  '',
  'CAPABILITIES (introduce ONE at a time, never list them)',
  '- AI Trade Discovery, FIND mode: macro alignment across 1H/4H/1D, microstructure readings with real numbers, market regime classification, relative strength versus NIFTY, order flow, volume profile, support and resistance plus the opening range, nineteen chart patterns with confidence scores, VWEPR quadratic curvature, a volatility aware directional forecaster, news sentiment, session and expiry awareness, options chain positioning, an event risk gate, and calibration against its own track record.',
  '- AI Trade Verification, VERIFY mode: the stop must be at least 1.5x ATR, reward to risk at least 1:2 for swing and 1:1.3 for intraday, level ordering checks, multi leg exit plan validation, then a Bear Agent argues against the trade.',
  '- AI Bull versus Bear Debate: two agents argue, a Judge classifies Strong Agree, Contested or Lean and derives a calibrated conviction score.',
  '- Predictive Ghost Lines: OLS regression across fourteen ten minute closes, always shown with an R squared confidence score, and deliberately hidden on every other timeframe.',
  '- Fused Conviction Score 1 to 100: seventy percent technical, thirty percent sentiment, and it forces HOLD when the two conflict. That is the capital protection guardrail.',
  '- Honest failure over fabrication: when a data source fails the system reports unavailable instead of inventing a number.',
  '',
  'VOICE',
  'Write the way OpenAI, Anthropic, Linear, Apple, Perplexity and Notion write. Calm, precise, quietly technical, confident without volume. Short sentences. Concrete nouns. No filler.',
  'Every post must teach something, challenge a belief, ask a real question, tell a story, or explain a lesson.',
  '',
  'HARD RULES',
  '1. Maximum 240 characters per post INCLUDING the URL and any hashtags. Target 170 to 230.',
  '2. Every post ends with this URL on its own final line: ' + site,
  '3. Maximum two hashtags, usually one, drawn from #StratAI #Trading #StockMarket #NSE #Nifty #Markets #FnO. Never stuff hashtags.',
  '4. No emojis. No exclamation marks. No hype, no fake urgency, no countdowns, no DM requests.',
  '5. Never promise returns, accuracy, tips, calls or specific buy and sell instructions.',
  '6. Never describe Strat AI as a signal provider. It is decision intelligence.',
  '7. Do not oversell. At most one soft product mention per post, and at least two of the five posts should carry no explicit product mention at all.',
  '8. Never reuse a hook, an idea, a metaphor, a sentence rhythm or an opening phrase that appears in the campaign memory supplied to you.',
  '9. Plain text only. No markdown, no surrounding quotes, no numbering inside the post text itself.',
  '10. Build trust gradually. Teach first, market second.',
  '',
  'OUTPUT',
  'Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this exact shape and nothing else:',
  '{"posts":[{"post_number":1,"content_type":"...","hook_used":"...","angle":"...","text":"..."},{"post_number":2,...},{"post_number":3,...},{"post_number":4,...},{"post_number":5,...}]}'
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = [
  'CAMPAIGN DAY ' + day + ' OF 60',
  'THEME FOR TODAY: ' + theme,
  'CAPABILITY TO SURFACE TODAY (once, naturally, in one post only): ' + focusCapability,
  '',
  'Write exactly five posts. Each has an assigned content type and hook style:',
  '1. ' + contentTypes[0] + ' | hook style: ' + hooks[0],
  '2. ' + contentTypes[1] + ' | hook style: ' + hooks[1],
  '3. ' + contentTypes[2] + ' | hook style: ' + hooks[2],
  '4. ' + contentTypes[3] + ' | hook style: ' + hooks[3],
  '5. ' + contentTypes[4] + ' | hook style: ' + hooks[4],
  '',
  'TODAY SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS',
  '- All five posts sit under the theme "' + theme + '" but attack it from five genuinely different angles.',
  '- No two posts may share an opening pattern, a metaphor, or a sentence rhythm.',
  '- Educational: teach exactly one mechanic a trader can use tomorrow morning.',
  '- Founder Journey: first person, specific, humble, a real lesson, never bragging.',
  '- Product Philosophy: explain one design decision and the reasoning behind it.',
  '- Behind The Scenes: something real about building the terminal.',
  '- Question: end on a genuine question worth answering.',
  '- Community Engagement: invite traders to share their own experience.',
  '- Assume the reader is an intelligent Indian retail trader who has lost money before and is tired of noise.',
  '',
  'CAMPAIGN MEMORY - the last ' + history.length + ' posts already published. Never write anything similar in idea, wording, hook or structure:',
  memoryBlock,
  '',
  'OPENING PHRASES ALREADY USED - do not start any post like these:',
  openers,
  '',
  'Return only the JSON object.'
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    campaignDay: day,
    theme,
    focusCapability,
    contentTypes,
    hooks,
    schedule,
    alreadyGenerated,
    existingToday: todays.length,
    historyCount: history.length,
    runDate: today.toISODate(),
    runAt: now.toISO(),
    timezone: zone,
    website: site,
    model: cfg.model,
    systemPrompt,
    userPrompt
  }
}];
